sampling: last available session of every calendar month, including explicitly partial 2026-10
risk_control: one centrally managed net book; no fictitious six independent funds; q_next=max(q,min(1,f+beta*max(loss(q)-buffer,0)))
impact: p_i(q)=exp(-A*z_i*q/D_i), D_i=d*c*ADV_i/sigma_i*sqrt(H); cumulative impact never resets between feedback rounds
cash_accounting: integrated execution price, signed short covering, fees, remaining positions; liquidation cash retained, not an investor redemption
volume_units: order quantity valued at pre-stress prices; daily dollar-turnover proxy; not measured order-book depth
capacity_definition: max reference capital with total q*|A*z_i|<=H*alpha*ADV_i for all assets and marked NAV loss<=5%; Feedback must converge
primary_materiality_gate: Feedback capacity haircut versus OneRound >=10% in at least two distinct calendar years among primary Equal/d=1 snapshots; descriptive feasibility criterion, not a p-value or empirical trading advantage
sensitivity_policy: report all four existing allocations and all three fixed depths; sensitivity cannot rescue a failed primary gate; no new parameter tuning
stop_policy: If primary materiality gate fails, stop application expansion; retain conditional results and research mainline. Passing only warrants review, never real-world utility acceptance.
evidence_limit: Retrospective real holdings proxies and OHLCV condition an uncalibrated impact/controller scenario. No new holdout, observed market-wide crowding, execution data, causal impact identification, alpha or trading-profit claim. No exogenous news shock or external-fund liquidation is invented.
